sections.heading: Using ServicePilot
sections.text: ServicePilot helps customers find approved technicians and manage physical service bookings. Customers select technicians directly; dispatchers review technician applications. Keep your account details accurate and protect your sign-in credentials. Customers must provide accurate job details, necessary access and only material they are entitled to share. Technicians must give accurate qualifications, service areas and availability, obtain permission for job photos and signatures, and perform agreed work responsibly. Approval is an application review, not a guarantee of every qualification or service outcome.

sections.heading: Acceptable use and content
sections.text: Do not commit fraud, create fake bookings or reviews, harass or threaten anyone, publish sexually explicit or sexual exploitation material, graphic violence, hateful or violent abuse, expose another person's private information, infringe intellectual property, impersonate others, gain unauthorized access, misuse personal data or disrupt the service. Reviews should describe a real service experience. Avoid passwords, identity documents, unnecessary faces, home details or unrelated personal information in uploads. Report objectionable users or content through the in-app report controls or Support & Contact.

sections.heading: Content and intellectual property
sections.text: You keep ownership of your uploads. You permit ServicePilot and its service providers to store, process and display that content only as needed to operate the service, show permitted reviews, manage jobs, handle safety reports and fulfil lawful obligations. Obtain permission from people whose information or signature you upload. Original code, branding, artwork, UI design and content actually owned by Sahan Wikramasingha remain his property. Unauthorized copying, resale, redistribution or misrepresentation of that owned material is prohibited, subject to applicable law and existing licenses. This does not claim ownership of generic ideas, user content or third-party material, or revoke rights already granted under a license.

sections.heading: Moderation and account access
sections.text: Authorized administrators can review reports and disable accounts; dispatchers review technician applications. Report review and account restriction are distinct from erasing data. Blocking hides that user's public content for you and prevents new bookings with them; it does not destroy shared booking history or evidence or automatically cancel an existing job. Contact support for an existing-job safety concern. ServicePilot does not provide an emergency response service. Report handling is manual; no guaranteed response time is currently published.

sections.heading: Policies and questions
sections.text: Agreeing to these Terms and acknowledging the Privacy Policy is required for registration and creating or uploading user content. This is not blanket consent for optional data collection. Location sharing and device permissions have their own choices. These terms do not exclude rights you have under applicable law or impose an unsupported liability waiver. Contact Sahan Wikramasingha at sahanwikrama29@gmail.com or 0767639021 for questions, correction requests or account-deletion requests. Third-party license and data notices remain applicable.

sections.heading: Who operates ServicePilot
sections.text: Owner / Developer: Sahan Wikramasingha. Privacy and support contact: sahanwikrama29@gmail.com, 0767639021. This policy covers ServicePilot customer and technician accounts and related service operations. Effective 2026-11-02; version 2026-11-02.1.

sections.heading: Accounts and profiles
sections.text: We process name, email, phone, address, account role, verification/account status, and registration Terms acceptance and Privacy acknowledgement versions/time. Firebase Authentication handles sign-in credentials and verification; passwords are not copied into public profiles. Technician profiles also contain specialty, experience, qualifications, certifications, declared service districts/areas, optional profile photo and availability. Account and job data support the service you request; security and moderation data protect participants and service integrity. Applicable statutory processing grounds and any legal retention duties depend on where the service is offered; contact the owner with questions. Optional location and media features use separate user actions and device permissions rather than relying on registration acknowledgement as consent.

sections.heading: Public and private information
sections.text: Signed-in eligible customers can browse approved technicians' public directory projections: name, specialty, experience, qualifications/certifications, service areas, availability, optional photo and rating/job totals. Reviews can show the reviewer's name, rating, comment, date and published review photos to eligible signed-in readers. Do not put private address or contact details in public profile text or reviews. Private user documents are restricted to their owner, authorized super administrators, and dispatchers reviewing technician profiles. Street/home addresses and private precise GPS are not copied into the public map projection. Authorized job participants and super administrators can access job records/evidence according to role and job permissions; dispatchers do not assign jobs.

sections.heading: Optional location
sections.text: Technician sharing is off until enabled. While sharing in the foreground, device GPS is stored privately and rounded to a grid for customer map browsing. Eligible accepted/assigned/in-progress job customers can access that technician's fresh precise shared location; other browsing customers see only an approximate area. OFF and account/logout cleanup revoke sharing; a network failure can delay confirmation and is reported in the app. Stale locations are labelled. Background tracking is not enabled. Declared service areas are separate from GPS. A customer's optional foreground fix is held in app memory for approximate straight-line distance, not saved remotely for browsing. You can refuse permission and still browse.

sections.heading: Bookings, uploads and signatures
sections.text: Bookings include selected participants, service description, address/contact, schedule/status, cancellation and work-timer information. Customers may select request photos; technicians may take before/after photos and enter diagnosis, work, parts and recommendations. A technician may capture a customer's drawn signature and approval for completed work. The signature is job evidence; the app does not perform biometric identification from it. Request/job media are restricted to authorized participants under the storage provider's rules; job evidence is also available to authorized super administrators. Published review photos have broader signed-in visibility. Notifications include personal job events and permitted system messages; read receipts track their read state. Reports and private block lists support moderation and your display/booking preferences.

sections.heading: Providers and security
sections.text: Firebase Authentication, Firestore and Firebase Storage support accounts, records and review/legacy media. Configured Cloudflare Workers support trusted booking operations and authenticated private photo access; R2 stores scoped request/job photos. Google Maps renders the Android map. Its Android SDK can automatically process device/SDK metadata, crash metrics, IP address and an SDK-specific pseudonymous identifier for service improvement; map interaction events may also be processed depending on SDK configuration. Expo and React Native provide the app runtime and device APIs. These providers may process network/device and operational information as part of their services; their own terms also apply. The app uses authenticated access, role/job checks, server-generated acceptance timestamps, separate public/private location documents, bounded queries and private media references. Review images are resized before upload. There is no claim of absolute security, a particular hosting region, or that provider logs/backups are erased instantly. Do not send credentials in support messages.

sections.heading: Retention, correction and deletion
sections.text: There is no verified fixed automatic retention period for account/job history, reviews, signatures, moderation records or provider copies. Correct profile details in Personal Information, turn location sharing off, manage device permissions, and use Support & Contact to request access, correction or deletion. Request account deletion in the app or email sahanwikrama29@gmail.com without the app. Send from your registered email when possible; never send a password, token, private key or unnecessary ID documents. Opening an email composer does not submit a request: you must send the email. The owner must verify identity, review associated Firestore/media/Auth records and explain any justified retention of shared job evidence, safety records or legal obligations. No guaranteed completion time is currently published. The existing administrator 'delete' action restricts access but is not data erasure; full erasure requires additional operator/backend handling. We cannot presently promise automatic deletion of all provider backups or logs.

sections.heading: Your choices and concerns
sections.text: Optional location sharing can be stopped in the app; photo/camera and location permissions can be changed in device settings. These controls do not remove previously shared records. Ask the owner about withdrawing optional consent and deleting retained material. You may raise privacy concerns with the owner and, where applicable, the relevant data-protection authority. A Terms acceptance or Privacy acknowledgement is not a claim of full legal compliance or certification.

sections.heading: Delete your ServicePilot account and associated data
sections.text: Email sahanwikrama29@gmail.com with subject ServicePilot Account Deletion Request. You can request deletion without reinstalling or signing into the app. Send from your registered email when possible and say whether you use a customer or technician account. Do not send passwords, tokens, private keys or unnecessary identity documents.

sections.heading: Sending your request
sections.text: The email button opens your mail composer; it does not submit a request. Review and send the email yourself. If no mail app is available, copy the address or use your webmail. The owner will need to verify account ownership before acting and should explain the deletion scope and any retention exceptions.

sections.heading: Scope and current limitations
sections.text: The request covers Firebase Auth, profile/public projections, locations, associated Firestore records and stored media, including review photos, request/job photos and signature evidence. Shared bookings, other participants' records, safety/audit records and provider copies require individual review rather than blind deletion. No verified fixed retention period or guaranteed processing time has been published. The current administrator delete action disables account access and does not erase Auth, Firestore or media. Full verified erasure and provider-copy handling still require operator/backend work; do not treat a disabled account as completed deletion.
